firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to store user profiles, projects, blog posts, and contact form submissions.  The structure prioritizes authorization independence, clarity, and security. User-owned data such as projects and blog posts are stored under the `/users/{userId}` collection to simplify ownership-based security rules. Contact form submissions are stored in a dedicated `/contact_form_submissions` collection. There is no user ownership. This supports listing contact form submissions without needing to validate user access. Authorization Independence is achieved because no `get()` calls are required in the rules. Rules are not filters since access is granted to the contact form submissions collection based on the request.
